В Android-приложении можно вести записи: You can use the Android app without an account. Your records are stored locally on your device and are available offline. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data may delete these local records.
После входа в аккаунт при включённой син: When you sign in with sync enabled, your records are sent to the server and become available on your other devices. Guest records and account records are stored separately. The web app requires an internet connection.
Отправку запускаете вы: выберите заметку: You choose what to share: select a note or list, then pick a recipient in Telegram. The message includes the text of the selected record. Once sent, it is subject to Telegram settings and policies.
На лендинге нет рекламных трекеров и фор: This landing page has no advertising trackers or data collection forms. The shopping list demo runs only on this page: your clicks are not sent to an account and reset when you reload. Fonts and illustrations are served from our website.
